topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Aye, neighbor, glad to see ye with that eager look in your eye. I've been tendin' this earth 'fore I could walk, and it seems right that you'd want a bit of soil to work with your own hands. I remember when I planted my first row, felt the seeds slip through my fingers into the cool earth, and watched 'em sprout come spring. This bit of land's seen many a family through lean times, and I see no reason it can't do the same for ye. Go on, take a corner, make it bloom. I reckon we'll have a fine harvest together, weather willing and the saints be kind.
